entries.0a023c3b53b7f597: Equipment that tests semiconductors that store data (memory).
entries.0d00bb8398aa0170: Tests whether a semiconductor operates correctly in the environment where it is actually used, built into a system or final product.
entries.216fb779fe5e970f: Equipment that automates semiconductor testing in the [[term:back-end-process|back-end process]]. It carries semiconductors, applies temperature during testing, and sorts the semiconductors based on the test results.
entries.44878f25f388a2de: Provides support services and sells consumables such as interface boards used in testing. Support service sales have grown as the installed base of ADVANTEST CORPORATION products has increased. Nanotechnology-related products are also included in this business.
entries.5dd8b48f916b1897: Equipment that tests semiconductors that store data (memory). Memory includes DRAM, which can be read and written at high speed, and NAND flash, which can retain data without power. Memory is generally produced in large volumes of a small number of types, and the equipment is built to test many semiconductors at the same time to suit that mass production process.
entries.70162dd101b35a41: Equipment that automates semiconductor testing in the [[term:back-end-process|back-end process]].
entries.9c34f9834fe5af6d: Manufactures and sells "semiconductor testers", which test whether [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]] operate as designed and meet the required performance and durability, as well as products used around testers, such as equipment that carries the semiconductors to be tested and the parts that connect to the tester. This business accounted for 90.3% of revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.a95d3553512d1eec: Manufactures and sells "semiconductor testers", which test whether [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]] operate as designed and meet the required performance and durability, as well as products used around testers, such as equipment that carries the semiconductors to be tested and the parts that connect to the tester.
entries.b0d0831d01070dcc: Tests whether a semiconductor operates correctly in the environment where it is actually used, built into a system or final product. It complements tests that examine a semiconductor on its own.
entries.c4e424b7c2040e75: Products for the part (interface) that connects the semiconductor under test to the tester.
entries.e0327b25f514f004: A company that makes test equipment (semiconductor testers) for checking that semiconductors operate properly, and related products, and sells them to semiconductor-related companies around the world.
